assessments.overlap: O has source-clock freshness/invalidation and recovery triggers, but not frozen-representation CKA plus calibrated CUSUM alarms.
assessments.uncertainty: Alarm constants/reset/warm-up remain incomplete; no O-like FAR/delay calibration.

assessments.overlap: O has held-out evaluation but no released-representation same-label visual-drift score/threshold substrate.
assessments.uncertainty: Released standard protocol is independent-window classification, not sequential alarm detection; wrapper defect is artifact friction only.

assessments.overlap: No quantile-calibrated drift controller with persistence plus post-alarm freeze exists in O.
assessments.uncertainty: Source domain is tabular/sensor drift and implementation provenance remains incomplete.

assessments.overlap: O proposes scoped candidates and checks protected targets before activation, but not invariant candidate generation plus target-only confidence fallback.
assessments.uncertainty: Guarantee is bounded linear regression with covariance/conditioning assumptions; experimental constants are heuristic.

assessments.overlap: O reuses scoped historical evidence but lacks explicit bias-bound admission with a live target-only shadow.
assessments.uncertainty: Current source adds a structured alternative, not a solution to structure-free unknown bias.

assessments.overlap: O has scoped comparison/protected regressions but no statistical lower-bound-on-transfer-gain admission.
assessments.uncertainty: New result sharpens target-certified admission only in a restricted linear setting.

assessments.overlap: O runs paired route/task comparisons but has no exact anytime-valid discordant-sign e-process.
assessments.uncertainty: Uses a stronger conditional per-task no-better/symmetry null, not every weak average null.

assessments.overlap: O freezes bounded units/manifests and scores completed outcomes, but lacks an explicit estimand gate for adaptive within-task sampling.
assessments.uncertainty: Validity is for the induced frozen finalization policy; asymmetric stopping can change the estimand.

assessments.overlap: O has fixed-horizon exact/held-out comparisons but no backward-induced anytime-valid terminal McNemar test.
assessments.uncertainty: Safe composite-null computation is unresolved; naive Monte Carlo approximation is not automatically valid.

assessments.overlap: O reports task counts/outcomes but not discordant-task information rate as a paired-evaluation resolution diagnostic.
assessments.uncertainty: Stopping-number figures are expected-log-growth approximations, not guarantees.

assessments.overlap: O values held-out/protected evaluation but does not explicitly vary held-out attacker strength at fixed monitor threshold.
assessments.uncertainty: One LinuxArena environment and three small families; no universal attacker ordering.

assessments.overlap: O already treats source/blob identity, exact tested scope and contradiction preservation as authority.
assessments.uncertainty: Source-level mismatch across Adapto bundles; not evidence the mitigation or method is generally invalid.

assessments.overlap: O has no iterative hard-negative attacker-mining loop for stress-testing a fixed detector/evaluator.
assessments.uncertainty: One ProtectAI DeBERTa-v3 detector and HASTE synthetic/judge pipeline.

assessments.overlap: O requires protected regressions and narrow negative scope, but not attack-subclass regression reporting under hardening shift.

assessments.overlap: O has repetition/method-change triggers and recovery controls, but not posterior fix-benefit versus damage-risk stopping.

assessments.overlap: O already implements manifest-bound effect dispatch, critical revocation/freshness/binding checks and fenced commit guards.
